article.title: Check your bank feeds every month
article.excerpt: A two-minute habit that saves a painful year end.

author.name: Marcus Webb
author.bio: Marcus runs payroll for our seasonal clients.

content.html:
Bank feeds save hours, but only if they keep working. Once a month, open each connected account and check the date of the most recent transaction. A feed that stopped three weeks ago is far easier to repair now than at year end.

What to do when a feed breaks

Reconnect it, then import the missing statement lines from a downloaded file so nothing is lost.
